profile.summary: Peace in Schools is a nonprofit based in Portland, Oregon that provides mindfulness education to teens and educators. Its main program, Mindful Studies, is a semester-long, for-credit mindfulness class offered in public high schools. It also trains and certifies high school teachers to teach the course in their own schools.
